# FreeGameStore MCP

> Remote MCP server for AI agents (Claude, Cursor, etc.) to build, publish, and improve
> games on FreeGameStore from the editor. Your model can author code directly
> (create_game + update_files) or hand a prompt to the platform's VibeCode agent
> (agent_build + edit_game), which writes and deploys. Games go live at
> <id>.freegamestore.online. Auth is delegated to auth.freegamestore.online (GitHub);
> ownership is enforced server-side via the store registry.

Endpoint: https://mcp.freegamestore.online/mcp (streamable-http)
Connect: npx mcp-remote https://mcp.freegamestore.online/mcp

## Tools

- Read (open): deploy_status, game_info, game_quality, leaderboard, platform_guide, sdk_reference
- Read (account): whoami, list_games, list_files, read_file, list_sessions, session_history, agent_status, mcp_audit_log
- Write (owner): create_game, update_files, agent_build, edit_game
- Destructive (owner): delete_game (confirm=game_id), discard_session (confirm=session_id)
- Admin (org members): admin_list_sessions, admin_session_history, admin_send_prompt

Write and destructive tools accept dry_run: true. delete_game / discard_session require a
matching confirm token. Failed calls return isError: true. MCP_READ_ONLY=1 disables every
write tool. Every write/dry-run/denial is audited to KV (90-day TTL, secrets redacted) and
readable via mcp_audit_log.

## Docs

- AGENTS.md: rules, capabilities table, workflow recipes, safety model
- README.md: overview and connection
- CLAUDE.md: implementation notes and gotchas
- server.json: machine-readable tool manifest
